description: A single-panel schematic (temperature–time profile) of the hot-compression test schedule used for FeeMneAleC steel. The y-axis is labelled "Temperature/°C" and the x-axis "Time/s"; neither axis carries printed numeric tick values, so every value appears only as text annotated on the curve. The profile has a linear ramp annotated "Heating rate 10 °C/s", a long plateau annotated "1200 °C, 120 s", a linear descent annotated "Cooling rate 5 °C/s", a second, short plateau annotated "Holding time 15 s", a zig-zag segment annotated "Compression" at the deformation temperature, and a final steep arrow annotated "Quenching". Nothing else is drawn — there are no curves, data points, legends, scale bars or micrographs, and no panel letters. The figure demonstrates the experimental route referred to in the caption ("Compression experimental process"): heat at 10 °C/s to a 1200 °C/120 s homogenisation hold, cool at 5 °C/s to the set temperature, equilibrate for 15 s, compress isothermally at constant strain rate, then immediately quench. The absolute temperatures and durations of the deformation stage are not shown in the schematic; they are supplied only by the citing text.

observations.observation: The figure is a temperature–time schematic with y-axis labelled 'Temperature/°C' and x-axis labelled 'Time/s'; no numeric tick values are printed on either axis.
The heating segment is annotated 'Heating rate 10 °C/s'.
The high-temperature hold is annotated '1200 °C, 120 s'.
The cooling segment is annotated 'Cooling rate 5 °C/s'.
A second short plateau before deformation is annotated 'Holding time 15 s'.
The deformation stage is drawn as a zig-zag (serrated) segment annotated 'Compression'.
The final stage is a steep downward arrow annotated 'Quenching'.
The caption labels this figure 'Compression experimental process'.
The citing text states the compression experiments were carried out on a Gleeble-3500 thermo-mechanical simulator.
The citing text states the experimental temperatures were 900, 950, 1000, 1050, 1100 and 1150 °C and the strain rates were 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10 s^-1; these values are not printed in the schematic.
The citing text states the maximum compression was 60%, corresponding to a maximum true strain of 0.92.

The citing text states mica foils with high-temperature lubricants were affixed to the two end faces of the sample to reduce friction and deformation non-uniformity; this is not depicted in the schematic.
The citing text states the sample was water-sprayed after compression to cool the steel, matching the 'Quenching' arrow in the schematic.
The citing text gives the material as FeeMneAleC steel with composition (mass fraction, %) 1.46 C, 25.14 Mn, 10 Al, 0.053 Nb, balance Fe, and a cylindrical sample of F 8 mm × 12 mm.
